lamplighters_intro.speaker: lamplighters
lamplighters_intro.text: You're not one of the wet ones. Good. We weren't sure, in the dark.

lamplighters_intro.speaker: patch
lamplighters_intro.text: Patch. Fox. Hero, technically. You two are the ones doing the rounds.

lamplighters_intro.speaker: lamplighters
lamplighters_intro.text: Our father's rounds. He lit every lamp in Lanternfold for forty years. The night of the flood he went up to the lighthouse and he didn't come down.

lamplighters_intro.speaker: lamplighters
lamplighters_intro.text: There are five lamps on the wharf he never reached. We can't get up to them. We've been cut from one strip of paper, and the wind takes us like a kite.

lamplighters_intro.speaker: lamplighters
lamplighters_intro.text: He'd have liked you. He liked people who said things like that and then did them.

lamplighters_progress.speaker: lamplighters
lamplighters_progress.text: Five lamps. On the shed roof, the crane yard, out along the flap. He kept a list. We kept it for him.

lamplighters_done.speaker: lamplighters
lamplighters_done.text: That's all of them. That's the whole round.

lamplighters_done.speaker: lamplighters
lamplighters_done.text: It's stupid. It doesn't bring him back. But from up there it'll look like somebody's still doing it.

lamplighters_done.speaker: lamplighters
lamplighters_done.text: Take this. It was his. He'd want it spent, not kept.

lamplighters_repeat.speaker: lamplighters
lamplighters_repeat.text: We'll keep the round going. Someone has to. You go and find whatever's doing this.

corrugate_intro.speaker: corrugate
corrugate_intro.text: Stay back. I'm armed. With a boathook. Somewhere.

corrugate_intro.speaker: patch
corrugate_intro.text: I'm not wet. Look. Dry fox.

corrugate_intro.speaker: corrugate
corrugate_intro.text: Hm. Corrugate. Captain, of a boat I won't sail. Something under the harbour flap has been dragging this town down plank by plank, and I've been in this shed for a week pretending I can't hear it.

corrugate_need_tape.speaker: corrugate
corrugate_need_tape.text: You'll want something to swing on, out here. The lamplighter kept a roll of tape up in his tower. He won't be needing it.

corrugate_cat.speaker: corrugate
corrugate_cat.text: Stay back. I'm armed. With a boathook. Somewhere.

corrugate_cat.speaker: patch
corrugate_cat.text: I'm not wet. Look. Dry fox. With tape, even.

corrugate_cat.speaker: corrugate
corrugate_cat.text: The lamplighter's tape. So you went up there. Then you know.

corrugate_cat.speaker: corrugate
corrugate_cat.text: Corrugate. Captain, of a boat I won't sail any more. Something under the harbour flap has been eating this town from below, and I've been hiding in a net shed listening to it.

corrugate_cat.speaker: corrugate
corrugate_cat.text: My cat's up the big crane. Crumple. She went up when the water came and she won't come down for me. I can't climb. I've tried. I'm cardboard. I fold.

corrugate_cat.speaker: patch
corrugate_cat.text: Then I'll go up. Light the lamp, ride the shadows, grab the cat. Easy.

corrugate_cat.speaker: corrugate
corrugate_cat.text: Nothing out there's easy, fox. That's what it does to you. Bring her back and I'll open the flap. I owe the harbour that much.

corrugate_cat_progress.speaker: corrugate
corrugate_cat_progress.text: Up the crane. The short lamp by its foot throws shadows up it, but they don't last. Move fast, and don't look down.

corrugate_joins.speaker: corrugate
corrugate_joins.text: There she is. Dry, and furious about it. Thank you.

corrugate_joins.speaker: corrugate
corrugate_joins.text: Right. I said I'd open the flap. I'm going to open the flap.

corrugate_joins.speaker: corrugate
corrugate_joins.text: And then I'm coming down there with you, because if I stay in this shed one more night I'll fold up for good.

heist_arrival.speaker: patch
heist_arrival.text: Gran's table. At night. Everything the size of a house, and all of it quiet.

heist_arrival.speaker: patch
heist_arrival.text: In and out. Nothing out here's on our side.

flap_arrival.speaker: corrugate
flap_arrival.text: Under the harbour. It used to be blue down here, you know. Properly blue. I learned to swim in it.

flap_arrival.speaker: corrugate
flap_arrival.text: Don't fall in. Things that fall in don't come out the colour they went in. Some of them don't come out.

kraken_arrival.speaker: patch
kraken_arrival.text: That's not a sea. That's a spill. With an eye.

kraken_arrival.speaker: corrugate
kraken_arrival.text: Blotch. It's been under the town since the flood, drinking.

kraken_arrival.speaker: corrugate
kraken_arrival.text: Blotting paper drinks ink faster than it does. Drop it on the beast and it'll sag. Then cut, fox, and don't stop.

kraken_drizzle.speaker: kraken
kraken_drizzle.text: ...I only wanted... it to stop... raining...

kraken_drizzle.speaker: corrugate
kraken_drizzle.text: Look at the ink, fox. That's not harbour ink. That's the Weather Page. That's Drizzle's ink.

kraken_drizzle.speaker: corrugate
kraken_drizzle.text: The flood filled that little cloud until there was no room left for it. This isn't a monster. It's what's left when the water won't stop and nobody comes.

kraken_drizzle.speaker: patch
kraken_drizzle.text: I know. I know nobody came.
